**Quick links are available in the companion document. This guide walks through common tasks.**

# ~~**Firm offer (completed)**~~

Most readers have already completed this step.

# ~~**e-Visa (completed)**~~

[Student Visa Application System](https://studentvisaapp.hku.hk/)

Complete step 8 after arriving in Hong Kong.

**Leave step 8 blank until you have entered Hong Kong.**

After entering on a student visa, sign in to the [HKU Student Visa Application System](https://studentvisaapp.hku.hk/) and complete the enrolment details in step 8.

Enter the visa expiry date shown on the landing slip issued when you enter Hong Kong. Check that it matches exactly.

1. Student — permitted to remain until dd/mm/yyyy (your visa expiry date).

2. Enrolled in an approved programme at HKU.

3. Your name in English.

4. Your travel document number.

5. Your arrival date.

The system will remind you to apply for an extension if needed.

# ~~D endorsement (completed)~~

Bring your identity card, firm offer and e-Visa to obtain the endorsement.

# Collect your student card

After entering Hong Kong, upload your landing slip in step 8 of the visa system using the expiry date shown on the slip. Then upload PDF copies of both your e-Visa and landing slip on the Compulsory Upload Visa page in SIS.

An automated email confirms the upload. Wait for the email with student card collection instructions.

HKU 指南#hku-系统注册指南:
**HKU registration guide**

A registration email should arrive a few days after your firm offer. The screenshot shows an example.

Read the full email.

![](/static/guide-originals/registration-eb9ce26fb000.png?w=1415&h=1002)

Scroll down to find your account email address and initial password.

![](/static/guide-originals/registration-bdf5f640075b.png?w=886&h=419)

Open HKU Portal from the email and enter your account address and initial PIN. When prompted to set up two-factor authentication, scan the QR code with Microsoft Authenticator.


**Instructions from the registration email**


Dear new postgraduate student,

Welcome to HKU. Please complete these registration steps:

| **Task** | **Details** |
| --- | --- |
| Complete online master registration within three days of receiving the email | Use your computer account details in [HKU Portal](https://hkuportal.hku.hk/login.html). Go to SIS → SIS Menu → Self Service → Master Registration. Register early to access course selection, hall applications and student card services. |
| Upload a photo and identity documents for your student card | Complete master registration first. In [HKU Portal](https://hkuportal.hku.hk/login.html), go to SIS → SIS Menu → Self Service → Student Card Document Upload. Submit all documents at once. Only one submission is permitted per student. Return to the page to check the submission status. |
| Upload your visa and landing slip and enter the expiry date | Non-local students entering on a visa must do this after arriving in Hong Kong. Go to HKU Portal → SIS → SIS Menu → Self Service → Compulsory Upload of Visa Documents. |
| Collect your student card | The example notice gives late August to September 2026. Your HKU email account will receive collection instructions when your card is ready. |
| Information for new students | See [the registration site](https://ase.hku.hk/mr2026), then Student Registration → Taught Postgraduate Registration. Bookmark it for reference. |

These procedures were introduced in May 2026. HKU uses your HKU Portal email account for official notices. Check it regularly or ask your faculty office for current registration information.

**Email for students admitted from 2026–27:** your [UID@connect.hku.hk](mailto:UID@connect.hku.hk) account is active while you study. If you leave before completing your programme, you lose access to that [student mailbox](mailto:UID@connect.hku.hk). After graduation, messages to your [student address](mailto:UID@connect.hku.hk) are forwarded to your [graduate address](mailto:UID@graduate.hku.hk) for one year, and you can continue using your [graduate email address](mailto:UID@graduate.hku.hk).
HKU 指南#hku港深通勤:
**Commuting between HKU and Shenzhen**

# **Lo Wu**

### **Which train to take**

On the return journey, East Rail trains go to either Lo Wu or Lok Ma Chau. Check the destination.

### **Opening hours**

The guide lists the Lo Wu crossing as open daily from 06:30 to midnight.

### **Connections**

The crossing connects directly to MTR Lo Wu Station on the East Rail Line.

### **On the Shenzhen side**

- Luohu Station, Line 1: exits A1 and A2 lead to the crossing.
- Renmin South Station, Line 9: exit B is within walking distance.

The guide lists the last Line 1 service to Luohu as 23:00 on regular days and 00:00 on public holidays from Airport East.

### **Suggested route: East Rail Line and Island Line**

This route has one interchange.

![](/static/guide-originals/commute-de20768ffd24.jpeg?w=1233&h=576)

**Tap the image to see the full table.**

Change at Admiralty.

### **Journey time**

![](/static/guide-originals/commute-fd55fcc9ce73.jpeg?w=1233&h=496)

**Tap the image to see the full table.**

Allow about 1 hour 15 minutes to 2 hours, depending on your journey.

Fares noted in the guide: Lo Wu to Sheung Shui costs HK$26.50, with a cross-boundary surcharge.

Sheung Shui to HKU is HK$24.50, or HK$12.40 with Student Octopus.

The student total in the guide is about HK$38.90 (RMB 33).
